assumption: A purpose-built layout engine for Markdown's closed set of node types gives reading quality equal to or better than HTML rendering.
evidence: Spike (2026-10-28) and phase 1 screenshots across four fonts and the corpus.
test_method: Render the markdownWeb examples 0-8 and compare side by side with their scripting.com HTML versions and with Winer's own Markdown browser (screenshots/rendered0.png).
